description: Former Silver Falcons aircraft retained in the orange white and blue team scheme, displayed at Baragwanath (Syferfontein) airfield, home of the Johannesburg Light Plane Club. One of the four surviving team aircraft withdrawn after the death of Charlie Rudnick. Listed by the SAAF and recorded by enthusiasts in 2013; no dated photograph after that was found, so currency is unconfirmed.
